why:
phase-427 W9 (2026-09-07) — LANDED. `Context::default_from_env() -> Result<Context, InitError>` (`packages/api/nros/src/init.rs:253`) exists under the rclrs spelling. Same name, same observable contract on a hosted build: it IS `nros::init()` (`:424`), which stays as the C++-symmetric anchor (`rust:init`), and both read the process environment through the one hosted resolver.

Why a `divergence` and not a plain match: the PLATFORM CONSTRAINT is that a freestanding image has no process and no environment (RFC-0089 "Context and `init`, settled"). There the same function resolves to `Context::baked()` (`:329`, `rust:Context::baked`) — the constants `NROS_LOCATOR` / `NROS_DOMAIN_ID` baked into the crate's build, from Kconfig on Zephyr — and the source it reports is `ContextSource::Baked`. The semantics survive with the source moved from run time to build time ("the environment this image was built for or launched in"), which is what makes the disposition `adopt` rather than `adopt-bounded`: a ported `let ctx = Context::default_from_env()?;` compiles and does what it says on every target, and the ONLY thing bounded is where the values came from, stated on the type and on the `source` field. The error type differs (`InitError`, see `rust:RclrsError`), invisible under `?`.

History: filed `gap` + `absent` by the phase-428 Q1 follow-through, re-verdicted `rename` (to `nros::init()`) by the phase-428 closure, decided 2026-09-07 (RFC-0089) and landed here. Hosted tests: `init::ros_args_refusal_tests::default_from_env_is_init`; freestanding: `init::baked_tests::freestanding_default_from_env_is_the_bake` (`cargo test -p nros --no-default-features --features alloc --lib`).
